answer: An operator running many aliases as a result pays for many distinct network origins and accepts the latency of spreading them thin, while each origin still has to clear the orchard quota and the atlas admission check. Submission rate is limited to 10 per autonomous system per minute, so a datacentre cannot pull quota for a whole farm from one uplink. Because the counters live in the karst ledger, a burst across neighbours is visible at replay instead of hidden. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
